title: The Last Light of Venice
premise: In 2042, Venice is slowly sinking beneath rising waters. When renowned glass artist Elena Ferro vanishes from her Murano workshop during a catastrophic acqua alta, detective Marco Vianello is drawn into a labyrinth of art forgery, ancient smuggling tunnels beneath the lagoon, and a conspiracy that connects Venice's drowning future to secrets buried in its past. The only clues: a half-finished phoenix sculpture and a cryptic note reading 'The lagoon remembers'.

characters.name: Marco Vianello
characters.description: A weary Venetian detective in his 50s, haunted by the rising waters that are slowly swallowing his city. Stubborn, perceptive, drinks too much grappa.

characters.name: Elena Ferro
characters.description: A brilliant but secretive glass artist in her 40s, known for her sculptures that seem to capture light itself. She discovered something dangerous in the old tunnels.

characters.name: Tomás
characters.description: Elena's young apprentice from Lisbon, talented but anxious. He clearly knows more than he lets on, torn between loyalty and fear.

characters.name: Contessa Morosini
characters.description: A wealthy art collector from an old Venetian family, elegant and ruthless. She will stop at nothing to possess Elena's final masterpiece.

characters.name: Luca Daminato
characters.description: A grizzled lagoon fisherman in his 60s who knows every hidden canal and tunnel. He was Elena's friend and holds a piece of the puzzle.

setting: Venice, Italy — 2042. The city is half-submerged, with elevated walkways, floating markets, and underwater ruins. Murano's glass workshops still operate on the upper floors.
tone: Atmospheric noir with melancholic beauty. The sinking city mirrors the characters' sense of loss and urgency.
